newsitem.title: GERMANY: Eurowings adds Germany-Poland flights from January.
newsitem.headline: Eurowings adds Germany-Poland flights from January.

text.p: German airline Eurowings Luftverkehrs AG said it will expand its Poland network next year with new services to Wroclaw and Katowice.
This will give it the largest Polish network of any western European airline with flights to the two cities, Cracow and Poznan, Eurowings claimed.
From January 13, Eurowings will fly daily on weekdays from Duesseldorf to Wroclaw and from Dresden to Katowice with an ATR turboprop aircraft.
Wroclaw was becoming increasingly important as a production centre for industrial machinery and the automotive industry, Eurowings said.
Katowice, as a major economic centre for the coal and steel industry, was attracting western investment from companies such as Adam Opel AG and Fiat Auto Spa, the airline noted.
The city will be linked into the Eurowings Dresden hub with connecting services to other German destinations. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44-171-542-7706 Fax +44-171-5017
